releases.name: opencode-listen-stt 0.2.0 — recording UI fixes
releases.body:
- The live level meter and the recording controls are now one contribution on the prompt footer, to the left of OpenCode's own values. They used to sit on `session.composer.top`, the slot `opencode-speak-tts` uses for its playback row; two layout contributions on one slot fought over the same node, and the other plugin's row was left painted but outside the live scene — its buttons could be neither clicked nor selected.
- **✕ cancel** now actually discards the recording. It was wired to the same action as **⏸ insert**, which finished the take and inserted the text instead of throwing it away.
- The meter holds a fixed width, so the recording label no longer slides left while the bars fill in over the first second or two.
